dz: 1830 年伦敦议定书确立了希腊脱离奥斯曼帝国的完全独立和主权，这是希腊独立战争的最终结果。
de: The London Protocol of 1830 establishes the full independence and sovereignty of Greece from the Ottoman Empire as the final result of the Greek War of Independence.

t: 创建了荷属东印度群岛皇家陆军.
te: The Royal Netherlands East Indies Army is created.
dz: 创建了荷属东印度群岛皇家陆军.
de: The Royal Netherlands East Indies Army is created.

te: Church of Christ, the original church of the Latter Day Saint movement, is organized by Joseph Smith and others at eith…
dz: 基督会(Church of Christ)是后天圣徒运动的原始教堂,由约瑟夫·史密斯等在纽约法耶特或曼彻斯特举办.
de: Church of Christ, the original church of the Latter Day Saint movement, is organized by Joseph Smith and others at either Fayette or Manchester, New York.

te: The Canterbury and Whitstable Railway is opened; it is the first steam-hauled passenger railway to issue season tickets…
dz: 坎特伯雷和惠特斯图克铁路开通;是首条发季票并包含隧道的蒸汽客运铁路.
de: The Canterbury and Whitstable Railway is opened; it is the first steam-hauled passenger railway to issue season tickets and include a tunnel.

t: 厄瓜多尔从大哥伦比亚获得独立。
te: Ecuador gains its independence from Gran Colombia.
dz: 厄瓜多尔从大哥伦比亚获得独立。
de: Ecuador gains its independence from Gran Colombia.

dz: 美国总统安德鲁·杰克逊签署了《印第安人迁移法案》，该法案剥夺了美洲原住民的土地权，并强制他们搬迁。
de: U.S. President Andrew Jackson signs the Indian Removal Act which denies Native Americans their land rights and forcibly relocates them.

t: 34 000名法国士兵在阿尔及尔以西27公里处的西迪费鲁克登陆.
te: Thirty-four thousand French soldiers land 27 kilometers west of Algiers, at Sidi Ferruch.
dz: 阿尔及尔入侵开始:34 000名法国士兵在阿尔及尔以西27公里处的西迪费鲁克登陆.
de: Beginning of the Invasion of Algiers: Thirty-four thousand French soldiers land 27 kilometers west of Algiers, at Sidi Ferruch.

t: 有三万四千名法国士兵开始入侵阿尔及尔,在西迪弗雷德吉以西27公里处登陆.
te: Beginning of the French colonization of Algeria: Thirty-four thousand French soldiers begin their invasion of Algiers, …
dz: 法国殖民阿尔及利亚开始:有三万四千名法国士兵开始入侵阿尔及尔,在西迪弗雷德吉以西27公里处登陆.
de: Beginning of the French colonization of Algeria: Thirty-four thousand French soldiers begin their invasion of Algiers, landing 27 kilometers west at Sidi Fredj.

te: William IV becomes king of Britain and Hanover following the death without surviving legitimate issue of his older brot…
dz: 威廉四世在死后成为了不列颠和汉诺威的国王,而他的哥哥乔治四世没有幸存的合法问题.
de: William IV becomes king of Britain and Hanover following the death without surviving legitimate issue of his older brother George IV.

te: After inflicting a series of defeats on Algerian forces, the French army under the Comte de Bourmont captures Algier.
dz: 在对阿尔及利亚军队进行一连串的打倒后,由布蒙伯爵手下的法军攻克了阿尔吉尔.
de: After inflicting a series of defeats on Algerian forces, the French army under the Comte de Bourmont captures Algier.

t: 大会机构(Assembly's Institute),即现在的苏格兰教会学院,是迎来孟加拉文艺…
te: The General Assembly's Institution, now the Scottish Church College, one of the pioneering institutions that ushered th…
dz: 大会机构(Assembly's Institute),即现在的苏格兰教会学院,是迎来孟加拉文艺复兴的先驱机构之一,由亚历山大·达夫和拉贾·拉姆·莫汉·罗伊在印度加尔各答创立.
de: The General Assembly's Institution, now the Scottish Church College, one of the pioneering institutions that ushered the Bengali Renaissance, is founded by Alexander Duff and Raja Ram Mohan Roy, in Calcutta, India.

t: 法国的查理十世放弃了王位而支持他的孙子亨利.
te: Charles X of France abdicates the throne in favor of his grandson Henri.
dz: 七月革命:法国的查理十世放弃了王位而支持他的孙子亨利.
de: July Revolution: Charles X of France abdicates the throne in favor of his grandson Henri.

t: 路易·菲利普在查理十世退位后成为了法国国王.
te: Louis Philippe becomes the king of the French following abdication of Charles X.
dz: 路易·菲利普在查理十世退位后成为了法国国王.
de: Louis Philippe becomes the king of the French following abdication of Charles X.

t: 比利时革命开始.
te: The Belgian Revolution begins.
dz: 比利时革命开始.
de: The Belgian Revolution begins.

t: 巴尔的摩和俄亥俄铁道公司的新"汤姆·拇指"(Tom Thumb)蒸汽机车牵引着一款牵引马车,预…
te: The Baltimore and Ohio Railroad's new Tom Thumb steam locomotive races a horse-drawn car, presaging steam's role in U.S…
dz: 巴尔的摩和俄亥俄铁道公司的新"汤姆·拇指"(Tom Thumb)蒸汽机车牵引着一款牵引马车,预示了蒸汽在美国铁路中的作用.
de: The Baltimore and Ohio Railroad's new Tom Thumb steam locomotive races a horse-drawn car, presaging steam's role in U.S. railroads.

t: 利物浦至曼彻斯特铁路线开通;英国议员威廉·胡斯基松(William Huskisson)被机车…
te: The Liverpool to Manchester railway line opens; British MP William Huskisson becomes the first widely reported railway …
dz: 利物浦至曼彻斯特铁路线开通;英国议员威廉·胡斯基松(William Huskisson)被机车"火箭"击中并被击毙后,成为第一个被广泛报道的铁路旅客死亡事件.
de: The Liverpool to Manchester railway line opens; British MP William Huskisson becomes the first widely reported railway passenger fatality when he is struck and killed by the locomotive Rocket.

t: 由知名人士组成的革命委员会组成了比利时临时政府.
te: A revolutionary committee of notables forms the Provisional Government of Belgium.
dz: 由知名人士组成的革命委员会组成了比利时临时政府.
de: A revolutionary committee of notables forms the Provisional Government of Belgium.

t: 比利时革命在临时政府脱离荷兰时采取法律形式.
te: The Belgian Revolution takes legal form when the provisional government secedes from the Netherlands.
dz: 比利时革命在临时政府脱离荷兰时采取法律形式.
de: The Belgian Revolution takes legal form when the provisional government secedes from the Netherlands.

t: 圣凯瑟琳·工地体验了马里安的外貌.
te: Saint Catherine Labouré experiences a Marian apparition.
dz: 圣凯瑟琳·工地体验了马里安的外貌.
